item.title: Leaf Reader 1.7.10
item.description:
• 新增 PDF 连续滚动和可靠的上一页导航，并加入论文式目录。
  • PDF 搜索改为渐进返回，同时提升 PDF、Web、EPUB 和 DOCX 的加载与高亮性能。
  • 加入内容寻址的 PDF 文本快照、DOCX 流式解析、文档缓存和过期任务取消。
  • 生词支持词元加词性分组、相关词形差异高亮和直接查看完整释义。
  • 新增事务式用户数据备份和恢复，API 凭据不会进入备份包。
  • 加强不可信文档、归档、缓存、运行时和凭据访问路径的安全性。

• Added continuous PDF scrolling with reliable previous-page navigation and a paper-style table of contents.
  • Made PDF search progressive and improved PDF, Web, EPUB, and DOCX loading and highlight performance.
  • Added content-addressed PDF text snapshots, streaming DOCX parsing, prepared-document caching, and stale-task cancellation.
  • Improved vocabulary learning with lemma-and-part-of-speech grouping, related-form highlights, and direct definition access.
  • Added transactional user-data backup and recovery while excluding API credentials from backup packages.
  • Hardened untrusted document, archive, cache, runtime, and credential-access paths.
